item.title: Watch Drake Freestyle at NBA Star Shai Gilgeous-Alexander’s 28th Birthday: ‘2 on the Jersey, But We’re Here for the 1’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard, the podcast where music meets the world of sports. I'm your host, and today we're talking about a birthday bash that brought together two Toronto natives, Drake and NBA MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.
[Short music transition]
Host: "Drake showed up to celebrate SGA's 28th birthday and even dropped a few bars in a freestyle, giving a shoutout to the Oklahoma City Thunder superstar. SGA posted the clip on social media, and it's clear these two are close friends. In fact, their manager, Simon 'Steez' Gebrelul, is also cool with Drake and manages several producers affiliated with him.
[Short music transition]
Host: "The two have been tight for years, and Drake has often been spotted courtside when SGA's Thunder visits the Toronto Raptors. He's even got a tattoo of SGA's Thunder No. 2 jersey on his arm. SGA has named Drake as one of his go-to artists, along with Giveon, Lil Yachty, and Justin Bieber.
[Short music transition]
Host: "Drake's been making waves in the music world too, with his trifecta of albums debuting in the top three slots of the Billboard 200 in May. And, fun fact, he even name-dropped SGA in his song 'HURRR NOR THURRR' featuring Sexyy Red.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
